reason: My first question is always whether it's really tested, and a named lab with a report per batch answers that. One sachet I just tear open also fixes my problem of forgetting vitamins on the counter, and $24.99 is low enough to try on impulse.
objection: I can't tell yet if the lab report is real or just a nice-looking PDF. And $30 a month is a lot if I stop taking it after a week like I always do.
